items.text: You're in Aetherius GCS — tick this off and keep this panel open
Plug flight controller into computer via USB
Flash ArduPilot — ☰ › Vehicle › Firmware, pick Copter, Plane or Rover
Connect to FC — click Connect (top right), pick your COM port
Set frame class — ☰ › Vehicle › Setup › Frame — Quad, Hex, Octo…
Set frame geometry — same page — X, +, V, H…
Calibrate accelerometer — ☰ › Vehicle › Calibration › Accelerometer
Calibrate gyro — ☰ › Vehicle › Calibration › Gyro (just click Start)
Calibrate compass — ☰ › Vehicle › Calibration › Compass, rotate through all axes
Wire RC receiver to FC — CRSF, SBUS or PPM port (check your FC pinout)
Bind transmitter to receiver — follow your receiver manual
Calibrate radio — ☰ › Vehicle › Calibration › Radio, move all sticks and switches to limits
Set flight modes — ☰ › Vehicle › Parameters, search FLTMODE — set Stabilize, Loiter, RTL
Set RC failsafe — ☰ › Vehicle › Parameters, search FS_THR_ENABLE = 1
Set RTL altitude — ☰ › Vehicle › Parameters, RTL_ALT = 3000 (means 30 m)
REMOVE ALL PROPELLERS before the next step — every one
Test motors — ☰ › Vehicle › Setup › Motor Test, all spin without grinding
Motor directions correct — compare to frame diagram on your FC manufacturer's page
Wrong direction? Swap any 2 of the 3 wires between ESC and that motor
Install propellers — CW prop on CW motor, CCW on CCW (printed on the blade or hub)
First-time setup done — use a pre-flight checklist before every flight from now on
